content_sections.heading: BSIP Scientist B Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: BSIP has announced a total of 19 vacancies for the post of Scientist 'B', carrying Pay Level 10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. The category-wise distribution is as follows: The institute has clarified that the number of posts may vary and it reserves the right not to fill any vacancy without assigning a reason.

content_sections.heading: BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet either of the following essential qualification requirements: M.Sc. or a recognized equivalent qualification with first division in Biosciences, Geology, Physics, Chemistry, or an allied discipline in Earth Science, along with 3 years of research experience in the relevant discipline. OR Ph.D. in a relevant discipline. Preference will be given to candidates with experience or specialization in any of the following areas, especially those supported by publications in national or international journals, including post-doctoral research experience: Palaeontology (Invertebrate/Vertebrate) Palaeobotany Palaeogeography Micropalaeontology Palaeoceanography Ancient DNA/Metagenomics Planetary Geosciences/Astrobiology Geoarchaeology Archaeobotany Palaeoecology/Palaeoclimatology Palynology Geochemistry Applied dendrochronology integrating palaeoclimates, human dynamics, and heritage studies Advanced applications of Artificial Intelligence and RS-GIS in Palaeosciences/Earth Sciences

content_sections.heading: BSIP Scientist B Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for the post of Scientist 'B' is 35 years . The crucial date for determining age is 4th September 2026 , the last date for receipt of applications. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

Send the hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of mark sheets, certificates, degrees, testimonials, and the Demand Draft in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF SCIENTIST 'B'" through Speed Post/Registered Post to the Registrar, BSIP, 53 University Road, Lucknow-226007, UP, so as to reach on or before 11th September 2026, 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for BSIP Scientist 'B' posts involves the following stages: All applications received within the due date will be screened by a Screening Committee. Only candidates recommended by the Screening Committee, after approval of the Competent Authority, will be called for a personal interview. Meeting the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically guarantee a call for an interview. The decision of the Institute regarding shortlisting is final, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BSIP has announced a total of 19 vacancies for the post of Scientist 'B' under Advertisement No. BSIP/SCI-B/01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application, along with fee payment, must be completed by 4th September 2026, 5:00 PM. The hard copy of the application must reach the Institute by 11th September 2026, 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for BSIP Scientist B?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. or equivalent with first division in Biosciences, Geology, Physics, Chemistry, or an allied Earth Science discipline with 3 years of research experience, or a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as of 4th September 2026, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and PH candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BSIP Scientist B posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/EWS candidates, payable through Demand Draft only. SC/ST/PH and women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for BSIP Scientist B?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission, along with usual allowances as per Institute rules.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for BSIP Scientist B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official BSIP website under the Career section, and subsequently send a hard copy of the application with required documents to the Registrar, BSIP, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for candidates who applied under the 2023 advertisement?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who had already applied for Scientist 'B' under Advertisement No. BSIP/S&A/02/2023 dated 14.02.2023 are not required to pay the application fee again, but they must still submit the online form afresh within the current deadline.
